description: Check a signed refusal receipt. Send header `x-anygas-receipt: 1` on any request and, IF Robyn refuses it, the error response carries a signed `refusalReceipt` recording what was asked, when, and why. This matters because when a provider says no, the AGENT gets the blame — a receipt lets you prove to your principal that you were blocked externally rather than simply failing. It proves the refusal HAPPENED; it does not claim the refusal was correct.

receipt.description: the full refusalReceipt object as returned
